items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Lenny and I and Joe and Eddie and let's see, there were eight of us altogether.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, you know, then he says, "I'm sorry, but I'm going to have to cut the band down, the way things are going now, he says we can't keep the big band.
So I am going to cut it down to 16 pieces, so I went out in good company. Lenny and I and Joe and Eddie and let's see, there were eight of us altogether.
What about Bix and Trumbauer? Had they gone already, or were they still there.
